objective: Build the Career Daily Brief / Pipeline Prioritizer so Chief can summarize new eligible jobs, tracker changes, Company Watch findings, application-status changes, deadlines/follow-ups and owner actions without duplicating source-of-truth state.
prerequisites: At least the Career Ops/tracker interface must exist; gracefully mark unavailable inputs rather than guessing.
allowed_scope: Aggregate read-only from canonical trackers/status stores and workflow outputs.
Prioritize by explicit deterministic policy inputs (deadline, eligibility certainty, application stage, freshness, owner flags); label unknowns and do not invent scores as facts.
Include regional scan health, newly added jobs, duplicates suppressed, application status changes, interview/follow-up items and owner actions.
Produce a machine-readable brief plus concise Chief-facing summary.
Make it schedulable for morning delivery but do not assume an external delivery channel is healthy until verified.
stop_conditions: Do not overwrite canonical career state.
notes: Part of the owner-mandated 2026-09-24 morning engineering cutoff. Continue independently around owner-only credential/admin blockers; record those in tasks-or-issues/overnight-owner-actions-2026-09-24.md. Do not duplicate equivalent pending/running work.
